facts.text: Bayville Farms began when Captain Adam Thoroughgood received a land patent in 1643, later becoming the area now known as Bayside.
The Emmanual Episcopal Church, founded in 1843, stands as one of Bayside’s oldest religious institutions.
East Lynnhaven Parish was established in 1895, with early meetings held in private homes before a dedicated church was built.
In 1915, the Star of the Sea Catholic Church was founded on Groves land, adding a new spiritual landmark to Bayside.
Willis Hodges, a free Negro, was arrested in 1844 for “unlawfully preaching” but was unanimously acquitted, marking an early civil‑rights moment in Bayside.
By 1921, two of Virginia Beach’s oldest restaurants, Tandom’s Pine Tree Inn and Hurd’s, began as oyster houses in the Bayside area.
